title: The Double
description: A county magistrate's daughter loses everything but regains her life by masquerading as a minister's daughter, overcoming injustice with help from Duke Su Xiao Heng, rescuing her imprisoned father, and upholding justice.

title: Sweet Teeth [Hindi]
description: Dentist Ai Jing Chu, who also teaches at Donghu University, is known to be the most handsome man at school. University librarian Zeng Li, however, is prejudiced against him because of a little misunderstanding. When Zeng Li's mother forces her to get braces, she tries to avoid Ai Jing Chu at all costs, but eventually still ends up becoming his patient. As the two interact more and more with each other, Zeng Li realizes that Ai Jing Chu is actually a very professional and caring person, and starts to develop feelings for him.

title: Plan C
description: A secret grassroots organization persistently fights to expand access to abortion pills across the USA keeping hope alive during a global pandemic and the fall of Roe v. Wade.

title: Love is Sweet
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: The Best of Studio C
description: A collection of the Best of Studio C. Come watch your favorite cast members in their greatest and funniest sketches. Playlists are organized by theme, such as Best of Christmas and Best of Back to School.

title: My Stepbrother by Day, My Forbidden Lover by Night
description: On a first-class flight to her mother’s wedding, broke scholarship student Lily spends one reckless night with Ryder, an irresistible football star. By morning, she plans to forget him—until she arrives at her new home and discovers he is her future stepbrother. Lily vows to stay away to protect her mother’s hard-won happiness, but Ryder refuses to pretend they are family.

description: Showcases an trip to the Vatican, so that a couple can annul a Catholic marriage.

title: C'est le monde à l'envers !
description: C'est le monde à l'envers !

title: Create Option C: My Journey with Cancer
description: An actress on the peak of her career, Lourdes Colon, was securing guest star roles on hit television series and movies. Always having felt that she was meant to do something greater, make an impact on the world somehow, the rising actress believed that her way of doing so was through the media. As she continued to feel that her purpose had yet to be accomplished she asked the universe through prayer and meditation for the answer and the answer came the day that she was diagnosed with Hodgkin's Lymphoma.

title: When C Goes with G7
description: When a heartbroken film school graduate, an unemployed UC Berkeley MBA graduate and a junior high school student converge at the music instruments store of an aspiring musician, quirky thoughts on everything from work and education to love and life emerge against a truly catchy soundtrack. Relationships end and hopes are occasionally dashed in this episodic drama, but few could complain that this isn't a thoughtful attempt to capture the sentiments of growing up in Hong Kong as we know it today.

description: In his past life, although too weak to protect his home when it counted, out of grave determination Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. Although he's the weakest in his class with the lowest talent, having only a red soul realm and a weak one at that, with the aid of the vast knowledge which he accumulated from his previous life, he decided to train faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life to train faster as well. He aims to protect the city from the coming future of being devastated by demon beasts and the previous fate of ending up destroyed. He aims to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath. And he aims to destroy the so-called Sacred family who arrogantly abandoned their duty and betrayed the city in his past life.

description: Computers, smart phones, and tablets are now a part of our daily lives. They have revolutionised the way we work, the way we communicate and the way we view the world. title: F**k Buddies
description: F*ck Buddies, we see a middle-aged man on his couch drinking a glass of scotch, when his daughter walks in, sits next to him and takes a swig. "How's your sex life?," he asks her, matter-of-factly. They drone on about his date and her new friends and when the scene ends, she replies, "to answer your question, it's going pretty amazing." The effect the show is going for is cool and casual; just a father-daughter duo knocking back after a tough day at work. But then you watch it again and notice that there's nothing else in the scene. It doesn't lead to anything nor does it reveal something new about Jiah (Jikki Nair), the show's protagonist. And when you realize that the father doesn't get a second scene in the show, you sense a problem. The scene was written exclusively for its shock value. Which is ok if the show was trying to achieve something that was truly shocking. Even its central concept, about two friends "benefitting" with no strings attached, isn't exactly fresh. Other than the novelty of such a scenario being set in Chennai, it isn't rocket science for it to be explained. The contrived "Rules of F*ck Buddies" for instance. 'No going out', is one. 'No texting or calling' is another. Not only are these rules spelled out, but they are written up, framed and hung on Jay's (Jaytesh) bedroom wall. For people trying to keep things casual without labels, they seem extremely finicky about the rules. It's a show that tries too hard to be hip and progressive, but in the process, it reduces millennials to a bunch of alcoholic dimwits with nothing but sex on their minds. How about some texture while writing these characters? I know nothing about Jay, even after the whole show, other than he's a YouTuber (don't know what kind) and that he's a "wet dhummer"(someone who only smokes when he drinks). The same goes for Jiah. She's free and sexually liberated but does every single scene have to play out exactly the same way. It's hinted that she has some sort of a disease but it's neither serious enough to do some real damage nor is it used in such a way that it contributes to the screenplay. F*ck Buddies is a show so excited to be able to use the F word (and its many iterations) that it forgets that those words have to also make sense. And for all its progressive take on a modern relationship, one wishes they'd taken a ballsier stand. What's more to say about a show whose only intention is to make the audience go WTF.

description: WHEN I WAS YOUNG I SAID I WOULD BE HAPPY is a feature length documentary about the transformation achieved by 12 orphan genocide survivors in Rwanda after participating in a new form of sustainable humanitarian aid called Project LIGHT. title: I polykatoikia
description: An artistic and subjective documentary exploring the apartment building as a uniquely Greek architectural model that has profoundly shaped the character of modern cities. Blending urban research with poetic reflection, the film examines the act of inhabiting space in an era of globalization and capitalism. At its core, it is the harmony - or perhaps disharmony - of a metropolis called Athens.

title: I Against I [Hindi]
description: Focusing on the timeless themes of jealousy, murder and betrayal, 'I Against I' is set over one night and utilises different time lines to reveal a dark and unexpected conclusion to a simple mystery premise. The main protagonists, opposite in character, take a frantic journey into a desolate nocturnal world with the common aim of survival, though once completed, the plot reveals a trap from which escape may be impossible. Taking influence from films like 'Le Samurai', 'Point Break', and new Asian noir, the film is a modern homage to hard boiled cinema with its own original take.

title: Saber Marionette J [English]
description: The male-only planet of Terra II is populated by clones of the six men who were marooned there 300 years before. The only females are robots called "marionettes," who serve as workers and soldiers. Japoness marionettes Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry are different from most others, because each possesses a special circuit that gives them human emotions. One by one, they are accidentally awakened by young Mamiya Otaru and take up residence with him. As a result, Otaru's uneventful life becomes just a tad more interesting. At the same time, conflict between Japoness and the city-state of Gartland is escalating. Is it because Faust, the leader of Gartland, lusts for world domination, or is it something else his heart longs for... something with a connection to Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry?

title: Tie Me (K)not
description: After enduring continuous physical and psychological abuse from her cheating husband and controlling mother-in-law, Lalita is too heartbroken to endure her marriage. When she seeks a divorce, her father disowns her. Lalita's life has been controlled by a man since birth, but no more. After the divorce, Lalita begins a journey of self-growth and advancement to prove that no girl needs a man to determine her worth. Alas, the road is filled with setbacks and obstacles. But Lalita is determined; she begins working as a model.

description: Spring 1945. The end of World War II is approaching. In Western Belarus, near Grodno, there is a gang headed by a hardcore criminal, a former accomplice of the Germans, Boleslav Kruk. At the same time, the corpse of a certain Sudin was found in Moscow, who turned out to be a repeat offender named Mordyonok. Investigating his death, the operative group of the Moscow Criminal Investigation Department, headed by Colonel Ivan Danilov, enters a former military pilot Chistyakov (aka Altunin), who has become a deserter and accomplice of bandits, connected with Mordyonok and Boleslav Kruk.

title: K-9 and Company
description: One time companion of the Doctor, Sarah Jane Smith returns to Earth and carries on with her journalist career. Now, in 1981, she has managed to rebuild her career and has come, a matter of days before Christmas, to her aunt Lavinia's (a famous scientist) house in the sleepy English village of Moreton Harwood to write a book and to rest after her world-travelling assignments. However, her journalist's nose sniffs out another mystery when she arrives to find Aunt Lavinia gone, and nobody knows where she is, but the local rumour is that she was the victim of a local witch coven. Worshipers of a pagan goddess Hecate gather to celebrate a festival by ritually murdering a friend of Sarah's. She needs help - and she gets it from a box from her friend "The Doctor." Inside the box is a metal robotic but almost human-like talking dog called K-9 that is built for Sarah Jane personally and together Sarah and K-9 sets out to solve the mystery and stop the killing of Sarah's friend.

title: M.A.S.K.

title: Lawless Lawyer

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
description: 1997: A student of folklore named Andrea Roberti hypothesizes the possible link between the horror literature of H.P. Lovecraft and the dark folk tales of the Po Delta, a mysterious and remote part of northern Italy. 2002: One of the directors of the film comes across a manuscript in Montecatini (Italy) which may have belonged to the American writer. This journal, dated 1926, describes travels in Italy through the Po Delta in search of inspiration in the form of local folk stories: the Filò Tales. 2004: A small, tough crew of international filmmakers is put together with the help of David, a New York actor, to make a documentary on the finding of the journal and on the links between Lovecraft and the Po Delta. If the manuscript really did belong to Lovecraft, it would be an extraordinary discovery. As soon as they begin, however, the filmmakers find that Andrea Roberti disappeared in mysterious circumstances many years before, his car found abandoned on the banks of the Po. The crew sets up its base in the town of Loreo - referred to simply as L. in the manuscript - as the author of the journal did. During their investigations the atmosphere of animosity and foreboding rises and they soon discover that strange and disturbing things have been happening in the area. Events that the locals are eager to keep secret. The film "Road to L." is the true account of what took place behind the scenes of the 11 day shoot, reporting how the failures and revelations experienced in L. came to resemble ever more a journey to... Hell. Did Lovecraft really come into contact with something sinister? Did Andrea Roberti stumble across something he wasn't meant to find? The documentary makers are stepping too far into the unknown...

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Vice, tinapatan ang talak nina Andrea at Jers sa Miss Q&A
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: Vhong at Ogie nagkapikunan sa mainit na puksaan
description:
Oooh lala-van na lavan ang pitik ng bewang nina Baby Dolls Arianne, Chloe, Johaira, Juby, Jelai, Eriel, and Ina. To welcome their era as an official P-Pop group at kauna-unahang Hype Group ng bayan, ginanap ang Baby Dolls Day.

Present ang mga social media personalities, Kapamilya at Kapuso "PBB" ex-housemates, beauty queens, P-Pop groups, "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" alumni, "Showtime Online U" hosts, at All-Star Games Basketball at Volleyball Team para makigiling.

Pagkatapos ng Baby Dolls Day celebration, bumida naman ang beki na may talak para sa buong nation. Meet CY ng Quezon City, Fema Braganza ng Pangasinan, at BRIGIT ng Laguna, ang mga talakera na sumubok masungkit ang korona sa Miss Q and A.

Minsan ang talak, may pagka-harsh, parang comment ni Ogie Alcasid, na hindi inurungan sa puksaan si Vhong Navarro. Kaya ang ilong ni Vhong, napuruhan sa laitan!

Naloka naman ang Madlang People sa sagot ng mga kandidata sa unang tanong sa Tumpak Ganern tungkol sa karakter sa Noli Me Tangere na sinasabing ama ni Maria Clara. Ang sagot ni BRIGIT, "Nutridamus!" Kaya biro ni Vice Ganda, kapatid ba 'yan ni Nutri Bun?

Sina Fema at CY ang umabante sa next round ng chukchakan, ang Wit Lang. Pagkatapos ng talakan, ang very 'pulchritudinous', sabi ni Brent Manalo, na si CY ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Pumadyak ang swerte at good vibes para sa mga pedicab driver na sumalang sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakaka-touch ang pagiging solid Showtimer ni Tatay Doms, na may iniabot pang liham ng pasasalamat para kay Vice Ganda at sa buong "It's Showtime" family. Pero, si Kim Chiu, nagtampo, dahil wala ang pangalan niya sa sulat na ito.

Pagkatapos ng aktingan, iisa lang ang naka-survive sa laro! Ito ay si Mavin, na kahit mahirap man ang buhay ay nananatiling masayahin. Kapang P300k ang napasakanya, babawi siya sa magulang niya. Pero sapat nang pambawi ang P40,000 na Li-Pot offer kaya dito na siya sa siguradong uuwi siyang panalo.

title: Vice ayaw pabalikin si Bong Bong sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

title: Miss Q&A Kyla
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

Mukhang na-inspire ang mga kandidata kina Michael, Ralph at Brent dahil sa unang round ay mabilis ang kanilang pagpindot at pagsagot. Sina Agua at Raux ang nanguna sa Tumpak Ganern at nag-face off sa Round 2 na Wit Lang.

Parehong magaling! Mga answers nila ay winning! Kaya naman 'it's a tie' ang resulta. Sa araw na 'to, mayroon tayong dalawang Miss Q&A Reyna TalakEra.

Sa pinakabagong inaabangan na 'teleserye' sa tanghalian, ang You Gotta Lyric portion ng Laro Laro Pick, pang-finale ang eksena nina Vice Ganda bilang MemeRimar at Vhong Navarro bilang Sergio.

From aktingan, back to hosting si Vice Ganda upang papiliin si Duday, ang lucky player from Mandaluyong, kung Pot o Li-Pot ba ang desisyon niya. Wala nang patumpik-tumpik pa, Li-Pot offer ay itinodo na! Kaya hindi na rin nagdalawang-isip si Duday, at tinanggap na ang Li-Pot.

Ngunit laking pagsisisi ni Duday dahil nang subukan ang POT question, tama sana ang sagot niya. Pero tulad ng ipinangako ni Vice Ganda, dinagdagan niya ng P5,000 ang papremyo ni Duday sa oras na makasagot ito nang tama.

title: Kandidata, excited MALOTLOT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
P-Pop rise! Nagdala ng fresh energy sa studio ang 12-member P-Pop group AZTER sa isang hataw at nakaka-LSS na performance ng kanilang kantang “Parang May Mali.”

Positive ang heart, pero dapat mabilis din ang isip dahil sa Miss Q and A, hindi sapat ang confidence at ganda kundi kailangan din ng wit. Nagpakitang-gilas sa talakan sina Tinderella Marie, C-Jay Ubias Tablit, at Serenity Winter.

Para bang na-manifest ni Tinderella ang sariling pagkalotlot dahil nagkatotoo ang sinabi niyang excited siyang “tumalot.” Siya nga ang unang naligwak matapos maunahan ng mga kalaban sa pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round.

Sina Serenity at C-Jay naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang, kung saan muling nasubok ang kanilang husay sa pagsagot sa playtime questions.

Umulan naman ng kilig at hiyawan sa studio sa pagpasok ng bagong duo na may hawak ng bowl of questions. Sina Brent Manalo at Ralph de Leon muna ang escorts for today. Para patunayan na deserve nila ang posisyon, daanin sa joke time ang audition.

Laging handa, ‘yan ang motto ng ating mga scout. Kaya sa pagsabak nila sa Laro Laro Pick, walang puwang ang doubt. Boy Scouts of the Philippines ang players for today's video. Ang swerte, sa kanila ba ay sasaludo?

Na-curious si Vice Ganda nang makita ang mga girl sa hanay ng players na bahagi ng Boy Scouts of the Philippines. Sa jackpot round, si Yel ang umabante para sa chance na maiuwi ang P200,000 POT money. Naibigay kaya ni Yel ang tamang sagot at naiuwi ang malaking POT money?

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Pak na pak ang mga kandidatang tumalak sa Miss Q and A Weekly Finals. Dahil sa malakas na cheer ng Madang People, napa-"and I thank you" sina Elthon Bequio, Trixie Gomez, Gabriela Duevall, Queen Sam Ri, Freda, at Kathryn Fernando Poe, Jr.

Ang mga accla, nagbardagulan at bumuo ng kani-kanilang grupo. Pero at the end of the competition, nangingibabaw pa rin sa kanila ang nahanap na bagong sisterhood... at may nahanap din na pag-ibig? Si Gabriela, na-love at first sight sa 'poganda' na si Queen Sam Ri. At totoo ba ang balita na may isang lasing na kandidata?!

Ang Top 4 na sina Sam Ri, Elthon, Freda, at Gabriela ang umabante sa Wit Lang round. At mula sa apat, dalawa lang ang nag-face off sa Beklamation. It's Sam Ri versus Elthon sa katanungan na, "Sa panahon ngayon anong mas nakakatakot, katangahan o kasamaan?"

Talak ni Sam Ri, mas nakakatakot ang katangahan dahil ito ang dahilan kung bakit marami ang nabibiktima ng fake news. "May mga taong matatalino pero nagtatanga-tangahan kaya nadadakip sila at napapaniwala ng mali," sabi ni Sam Ri.

Mula NCR, sumugod sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang Madlang Players na nangtatrabaho sa printing shops. May isang player ba na magpapa-tarpaulin ng "congrats" dahil na-hit ang jackpot?

Ay, nakaka-in love talaga! Nakisali pa sweet-sweet-an sina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga, na pinakilig ang Madlang People sa kanilang 'rainy moment' na eksena!

Pagkatapos ng It's Giving, You Gotta Lyric, at Laro Laro Pick rounds, ang joy ay kumapit kay player Joy.

title: Miss Q&A: Barbie Bratz
description:
Kung may sariling opinyon, 'yan ay karapatan! Basta't may respeto pa rin, huwag matatakot ipahayag ang paninindigan. Nagbabalik ang limang Miss Q and A 'ResBAKS' na sa talakan ay walang inuurungan, sa weekly finals ng Resbakulawan round.

Pare-parehong 'nalotlot' sa unang sabak sa pagtalak, but now they're back stronger and fiercer, still with a dash of laughter. From the daily Resbakulawan, oras na para sa final face-off nina Barbie Bratz Ayuda, Andrea Jane Peralta, Misis Jawo, Miss Mia, at Carla Flores Argonza sa “It’s Showtime” July 25 episode.

Hindi maiwasan ang lutang moments sa unang round. May nabibingi sa tanong, at merong hula-hula lang ang sagot. Si Andrea ang unang naligwak sa laban. Pero bumawi ang candidates sa Wit Lang round.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, sina Barbie Bratz at Carla ang umangat at nagharap sa Beklamation, kung saan pareho silang palaban sa katanungan na, "Ano ang mas gusto mo, maging pride o joy ka ng magulang mo?" Naghatid nga ng pride at joy sa kanyang mga magulang si Carla dahil siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Resbakulawan weekly winner.

Ika'y mapapangiti sa ganda ni Bianca Umali, na guest co-host nina Vice Ganda at Amy Perez sa Laro Laro Pick, July 25 episode ng “It’s Showtime,” kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Don Bosco, Paranaque.

Si Joan ay tumama kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round for the chance to win P100,000. Matapang na sinugalan ni Joan ang POT question, ngunit bigo siyang maibigay ang tamang sagot.

Sa dulo ng programa, naglabas ng isang statement si Vice Ganda. Aniya, nakarating sa pamunuan ng "It's Showttime" ang mga komento ng viewers at netizens na na-offend o hindi nagustuhan ang ilang jokes ng hosts, partikular na sa 'Memerimar' episodes sa Laro Laro Pick kaya naman humingi ng dispensa si Vice.

title: Ahtisa, pinuri ang Miss Q&A segment
description:
Major throwback feels ang hatid ni New Zealand singer-songwriter na si Bic Runga sa “It’s Showtime” nang kantahin niya ang kanyang hit na “Sway," na bahagi na ng playlist ng maraming Pinoy, lalo na noong ’90s at early 2000s.

Huwag ubusin ang wit, dapat laging may reserba lalo na kung sa 'Miss Q and A' ka eeksena. Pak na pak na palakpakan ang sumalubong kina Mariposa Jem Lacsina, Affarah Deur, at Curevedilol Filipinas Galore as they walked the runway and left the crowd wanting more.

Dahil kakaiba mga pangalan ng mga kandidata, na-curious si Vice Ganda at inalam ang kuwento sa likod ng mga ito. Kung ang "It's Showtime" family naman ang papipiliin, ano ng gusto nilang maging 'beki' name? Back to the pageant, hindi tumalab ang full pack makeup ni Curevedilol sa pabilisan sa pagpindot at pagsagot. Siya ang unang umuwing lotlot. Sina Mariposa at Affarah naman ang nag-face off sa Wit Lang.

Mga bituin at diskarte ang kanilang gamay para sumakses sa buhay. Swerte ay maningning, kaya POT money ang goal sungkitin ng madlang players mula Tala, Caloocan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick.

Agaw-eksena ang galawan ni player Rian. Kung twerking lang naman kasi ang labanan, si Jackie Gonzaga ay wit niya uurungan. Na-shookt ang everybody, lalo na si Vice Ganda, sa wild moves ni Rian sa dance floor. Para bang makabagong bunot ang peg!

Kinaaliwan naman ni Meme Vice si Gara, isa labandera, dahil super natural lang ng cuteness at charisma nito. Pero naging emotional si Gara nang mapag-usapan ang kanyang asawa. Na-touch si Meme sa kuwento, kaya may pakimkim na agad itong abuinaldo bago pa man dumating ang Pasko.

Kay Gara nga kumapit ang swerte. Sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante! Nadoble pa ang kanyang aguinaldo dahil umuwi siyang may tatlumpung libong piso, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: WALANG WINNER TODAY sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

Dahil brand new ang week, may fresh batch of "Miss Q and A" candidates na nag-hello sa "It's Showtime."Ganap na ganap sa puksaan at talakan sina Binibining Dana, Jinger Aman Villamor, at Wynzhl Bansagan.

Pagkatapos ng Tumpak Ganern round, sina Jinger at Binibining Dana ang nakalusot, samantalang si Wynzhl ay umuwing lotlot" Anong mas ayaw mo kapag matutulog, ‘yung may maingay na aso o may katabi na amoy aso?" ang tanong na nabunot ni Jinger. Sakto because she's a loving fur mom! Pero mukhang hindi sumakto ang sagot niya kina hurados Bianca Umali, Ralph de Leon, at Nicole Cordoves. Gano'n din ang komento nila sa sagot ni Binibining Dana, na tumalak tungkol sa mga bestie na snaky.

Biro ni Vice Ganda, parang walang winner today. Pero maya-maya pa ay kinoronahan ang totoong reyna. Sa araw na 'to, si Jinger ang itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Samantala, ginamit din ni Brent Manalo ang boses para 'tumalak' sa ipapatayong AI and semiconductor industrial hub, Pax Silica, sa kanyang hometown sa Tarlac. At sa pagbabalik ni Darren, naipit si Jackie Gonzaga, na sa sobrang haba ng hair ay balik-love triangle with Darren at Brent.

Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, nagpahinga muna ang mga players na masahista. Minalas no'ng una pero bumawi ang swerte kay player Budang, na nabunot para sa jackpot round. No'ng una ay ipinaglaban niya ang POT para sa inang may cancer, at kapatid na may sakit sa puso. Pero, minsan panalo na rin ang sigurado, kaya sa dulo, forda Li-Pot na si Budang sa halagang P30,000. Sinunod niya si nanay.

title: Vice, sinala ang TALENT ng mga Miss Q&A candidates
description:
Paligayahin muna ang mga puso sa good vibes na dala ng "It's Showtime" family, at chill jamming with "The Voice USA" champ Sofronio Vasquez, na bagay na bagay sa cuddle weather ang boses.

Kuwentuhan na lang tayo, biro ni Vice Ganda sa mga kaibigang sina Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario bago magsimula ang 'Miss Q and A.' Napa-reminisce ang trio sa mga kuwentong ulan at kuwentong baha nila noong kabataan.

Full of hope naman ang talak nina Miss Q and A candidates Namssie Lopez, Raine Garcia, at Eron Tuico Arganosa. Bago ang talakan, sa talent muna sila nagpasiklaban! Pati sina hurados Nicole Cordoves, Brent Manalo, at Karylle napilitang mag-sample ng talent!

Sina Namssie at Raine ang sumalang sa witty tanungan sa Wit Lang round. Para kay Namssie, "Alin ang mas pipiliin mo, pangit ang araw mo pero maganda ka, o maganda ang araw mo pero pangit ka?" Nabunot naman ni Raine ang tanong na, "Anong mas ikakaglit ng sinaing, 'yung nasunog siya o hindi na-on ang rice cooker?"

Dakila ang kanilang hanapbuhay bilang mga kasambahay. Kaya deserve nila ang mag-relax muna at magpahinga sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Makihula at maki-POT at Li-Pot kasama ang mga kasambahay ng San Pedro, Laguna.

Naantig si Vice sa kuwento ni player Wency, na sa pamamagitan ng paglalaba at pagsisilbi sa mga amo ay nakapagpatapos ng mga anak sa kolehiyo. Naramdaman ni Vice ang saya ng isang inang nakapagpa-graduate ng anak sa pamamagitan ng sariling pawis at sakripisyo.

Binigyan ni Vice ng tig-sampung libo ang bawat kasambahay na naglaro sa game arena. Naiyak ang isang player sa ayuda ni Vice dahil, aniya, saktong nangangailangan siya ng pera upang makalipat ng tirahan.

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na makakabalik sa game arena. Si Ocel ang biniyayaan ng universe ng second chance. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer ng "It's Showtime" hosts. Malaking bagay na ito kay Ocel, kaya naman "Li-Pot" ang kanyang sigaw!

Isang eliminated player naman ang nakakuha ng P50,000 dahil sa ibinigay na pagkakataon ni Vice Ganda na sagutin ang POT question.

title: Meme Vice, naguluhan sa pagkatao ni Miss Q&A Rexy
description:
Ang naghatid ng feels na tunay, ang 'love team' na OA magpangiti, sina ex-"PBB Collab" housemates Dustin Yu at Bianca De Vera a.k.a. DustBia. Sa pagsayaw pa lang ng "Oohh Lala Baby," ang hiyawan ng fans parang umabot na sa ibang galaxy.

Ipinamalas naman ng T-MATES ang husay ng Pinoy sa pagsasayaw, na kanila ring ibinandera sa World of Dance Dance Summit 2026 kung saan napabilang sila sa Top 6 finalists.

Buong universe ang kayang sakupin ng mga Miss Q and A candidates with their beauty and wit. Parang stars na kumikinang sina ML Tucay ng Pangasinan, Rexy Morales ng Nueva Ecija, at Dessy Baldomero ng Marikina as they slay sa pagrampa.

Si ML, beterenang kontesera na 'idol' ng mga kapwa niya kandidata. Volleyball naman ang hilig ni Dessy, ang 6-footer beauty. 'Bunot' naman ni Vice Ganda si Rexy, na super cute sa kanyang paningin. Pero ang cuteness niya, hindi umubra sa Tumpak Ganern round ung saan ‘lotlot’ ang kanyang inabot. Aray! Si Rexy, napa-cry!

Hindi naman luhaan sina hurado Marina Summers, Brent Manalo, at Nicole Cordoves dahil pak na pak ang 'chukchak' ng dalawang kandidatang tumalak sa Wit Lang round. Saksakan ng galing ang answer ni ML, kaya for today's video, sa kanya ang korona bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era.

Shining bright ang good vibes sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, kasama ang mga estudyanteng bright din ang future. Sila ang mga Dean's Lister at President Lister's players!

Nakipagkuwentuhan ang hosts kay Lauren, na nag-share kung paano napapanatiling masaya ang buhay-estudyante sa kabila ng pressure. Parang literal na 'pressured' naman si Arnel, na pinaikot-ikot nina Vice Ganda, Amy Perez, at Kim Chiu habang ini-interview.

Si Jackie Gonzaga, na-pressure naman sa dalawang manliligaw niya. Para bang 'the plot thickens' sa love triangel nila ni Brent Manalo at Darren Espanto sa Act-Song!

Pasok sa listahan ng jackpot players si Jelo, na bet maging isang newsroom staff someday. Heto ang latest news: si Jelo, natagpuang matapang at tinanggihan ang P35,000 Li-Pot offer kapalit ng pagkakataon na masagot ang P250,000 POT question.

title: MC at Lassy, 'NAGSABUNUTAN' sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sa "It's Showtime" entablado they're always getting fiercer and fiercer with their new single "Spider." Here comes DNA, ready to slay! Ang singing trio nina Tasha, Julia at Ezri, nagpasikat sa harap ng Madlang People.

Ang pag-ibig, wala 'yan sa edad o kasarian. Kapag tumibok ang puso, huwag nang itago. Ipagsigawan ang damdamin! Ang feelings, aminin! Parang mga Miss Q and A candidates na hindi nagpapigil sa self-expression at pagtalak para marinig ng buong nation.

Mega slay sa pagrampa at talakan na havey ang queens na sina Francyne Astronomia, Kiana Ortega, at Dha-Dha Aringo.

Si Francyne na softie girlie, idol si Overtime Diva, Miss Trina. As a student, hate na hate niya 'yung mga kagrupo na palaging late. Si candidate 3, Dha-Dha, ipinakilala ang kanyang girlfriend of 9 years na si RR.

Sina Dha-Dha at Kiana ang umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talino at creativity sa mga tanong na mapaglaro't nakakalito. Mas nagustuhan nina hurados Max Collins, Michael Sager, at Nicole Cordoves ang talak ni Kiana, kaya siya ang kinoronahan bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Humataw nang wagas at napasigaw nang malakas ang Madlang Players mula San Jose, Navotas. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, malakas din ba ang swerte nila?

Malakas talaga ang chemistry ng DaCkie! Madlang People ay kinilig sa eksena nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. May pananagutan na?! Si Sergio (Vhong Navarro), nami-miss si Memerimar (Vice Ganda). Sobrang longing naman 'yan! Ang ating leading man, naghanap ng bagong Memerimar—walang iba kundi si Ryan Bang!

Sina Enteng at Mayang, parehong naka-survive sa You Gotta Lyric. Pero sa 'Laro Laro Pick,' one point lang ang kinailangan ni Mayang para umabante sa jackpot round kung saan nagkaroon siya ng pagkakataon na manalo ng P150,000.

title: Miss Q&A Mentoy ibinahagi ang 'traumatic' experience
description:
Stay safe and stay dry, Madlang People! Kung malakas man ang buhos ng ulan, stay home muna as much as possible. "It's Showtime" and chill muna sabay sayaw ng moves na nakaka-"Oooh Lala!" Kaninong pambato ang panalo sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance for today's video?

With full energy para ang banter ay mas havey, Vice Ganda hosted the Miss Q and A segment with Jhong Hilario at Vhong Navarro. Kung na-miss n'yo ang bardagulan at puksaan ng trio, heto na, walang kulang!

Sa haba man ng kuwentuhan with candidates Divine Geralde, Vavaing Vurdado, at Mentoy Alexa Ang, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy.

Struggle is real ang ma ‘accla’ sa tawag sa baby Elephant, at pati sa lugar sa Bulacan kung saan sumasayaw ang mga babaeng humihiling na magka-anak. At ang iconic quote ni Julius Caesar, nabago na pala?!

Hirit ni Meme Vice, "Ang sakit sa bangs!" Pero bumawi naman sa Wit Lang round ang dalawang kandidatang pasok sa chukchakan, sina Mentoy at Vavaing Vurdado. Parang bumaliktad ang mga pangyayari, dahil ang performance ni Mentoy, bawing-bawi! Satisfied at masaya si Meme!Sa dulo, wagi si Mentoy bilang Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era of the day.

Kasintapang ng kape ang fighting spirit ng mga baristang sumalang sa game arena kung saan sanib pwersa sina Vice Ganda at Karylle with Tyang Amy Perez.

Parang kape na ayaw mong tigilan, 'amats' naman ni Vice Ganda ang intern ng programa na biglang napasali pa sa aktingan. Samantala, para bang hindi basta aktingan lang ang hugot ni Ryan Bang kay Kim Chiu sa isang eksena. Hopia ba talaga?!

Saktong timpla ng swerte at diskarte ang mayroon si Ver, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante. Sumugal si Ver sa POT question, na may kinalaman tungkol sa kapeng barako.

title: The R&B Feeling
description: 1971, the Los Angeles performance art scene is flourishing. Chris Burden has just ordered a studio assistant to shoot him in the left arm with a rifle, Barbara T Smith is staging provocative interventions at F-Space, and Paul McCarthy is painting his naked body with mustard and ketchup in the name of art. And among them all, Bob Parks: an energetic young artist from the UK, living with his beautiful and interesting San Fransiscan wife, Myriam Morales. Life is perfect, for a time. But when Bob's marriage fails, and Myriam leaves for Santa Fe, things fall apart. He walks the streets of Los Angeles for a year in a string bikini and sees his burgeoning art career come to pieces. Having been rescued by the parishioners of a South Central gospel church, and having spent six years worshipping and singing alongside them, Bob finally moves back to the UK to live with his parents in the New Forest. Despite planning to stay for only six months to finish a series of paintings and gather his thoughts, Bob stays for thirty years. We meet him as he continues to develop his art practice, continues to sing in a gospel church and continues to explore what he calls "the R&B feeling". Against this backdrop, Bob attempts to break free of a constraining and mutually dependent relationship with his mother, Miggie, whose health is failing. As time goes on Bob's obsession with his mother - and her impending death - deepens, before reaching a terrible and tragic conclusion.

title: You're Fired
description: Railroad magnate Gordon Rogers agrees to allow his daughter, Helen, to marry wealthy idler Billy Deering, Jr., but only if the latter can hold the same job for one month. Billy is hired for an array of jobs, including office clerk and xylophone player, but always quits just before being fired. He then finds work in a restaurant where he is required to dress as a knight in armor and pose as a statue. On one occasion, Gordon, Helen, and Billy's romantic rival, Tom, enter the restaurant, and Billy is nearly fired when Helen recognizes him. Meanwhile, Gordon plans to merge one of his railroads with a company that is in a dispute with Tom's uncle, an unprincipled financier. Acting on the promise of a generous cash reward, Tom is determined to steal documents relating to the merger. Billy manages to stay at his job for thirty days, and in the process, exposes Tom's scheme, winning Gordon's consent to marry Helen.

title: Hovory s TGM
description: On 26 September 1928, Karel Capek and President T.G. Masaryk meet in the gardens of Topolcianky castle to decide about the fate of their joint literary work. Their fiction film dialogue is based on quotes from a future book and their mutual correspondence, considerably freeing the original format of literary conversation from binding conventions. Capek and Masaryk reproach and offend each other, but they also ask key personal questions and questions about the social functions of a writer and politician respectively. "It's a film about two extraordinary men; it's about the fact that emotions can be sometimes more powerful than ideas even in such exceptional people.

title: Mír s tuleni
description: Framed by two stories, this feature documentary fable PEACE WITH SEALS deals with the concept of "human nature". The first story is about a seal named Gaston who, according to the Prague Zoo director, became "the most famous animal on earth" after he managed to reach Germany during a devastating flood. At the height of his fame, Gaston was adopted by the former Prime Minister Gross; after Gaston's death, the Prague Zoo erected a statue in his memory. The second story took place 50 years earlier and tells the life story of a seal named Ulysses, caught in Sardinia by a Milan photojournalist who, in front of the cameras, tossed the animal into the famous Di Trevi fountain. Patellani - a friend of Federico Fellini's and a specialist on film stars - was fined for his action. The reason, however, was not the killing of a baby seal but the pollution of water in the fountain. Fellini took inspiration from the story for "La Dolce Vita"; referring to photojournalists such as Patellani, he coined the term "paparazzi", i.e. those who create the "nature" of contemporary man. What changes mark our relationship with animals? Today there are urban nature reserves, aquariums instead of oceans, and seal hunting can be booked with a travel agent. In the time of Homer, seals were the most widespread inhabitant of Europe's largest biotope, the Mediterranean Sea. Today, with sun tanning being so fashionable, people have replaced the seals on the beaches. Seals have become one of the most endangered mammals in Europe. Where will we be able to encounter wild animals in the future? How are animals being domesticated? And what is the domestication of people?

title: Tod@s caen
description: Adán (Omar Chaparro) is a charming seducer who believes he knows how to make any woman swoon. He prepares to teach his friends the art of conquering women, using his array of bullet-proof rules of seduction. Mia (Martha Higareda) is an ambitious producer who dreams of having her own TV show on women empowerment called "Todos Caen," a strategic guide to dating that teaches you just how to hook a man--and have him eating out of your hand in no time. Mia and Adán cross paths at a bar one fateful night, and from there the game is on in an all-out battle of the sexes. But as they test their finely-honed seduction strategies on each other, both find that sometimes the more you play hard to get, the harder you may end up falling.

These are true stories of human feelings, bright and passionate, mature and merciless. They range from the naïve and absurd, to the odd and comical, to the lucky, to the melancholy.

title: The 90's. The 00's.
description: The story of the first decades of New Russia, the 1990s, the 2000s. The project is full of interviews with leading politicians, businessmen, artists, producers, showmen and documentary material. People and events which made this country we see it today.

title: Razhodki s angela
description: Stephan is a sculptor. He refuses to do work that compromises his integrity. He has a guardian angel he talks to. We can't see him but we can hear his voice commenting on events Stephan gets involved in. As he crosses paths with the Artist, the Professor, the Director, the Poet, the Musician, the Actress and the Beloved, a world of characters arises to display a whole array of personalities and lives that share the spark of the creative spirit but also the lack of successful career. The voice of the angel reflects upon patronage in art and protecting your talent against corruptive forces, yet not through escapism but by learning the rules of the game.

title: Tí@s

title: s-CRY-ed
description: A strange environmental phenomenon 22 years ago in the Kanazawa prefecture caused the land to split and protrude upwards reaching unprecedented heights, creating the secluded area known as The Lost Ground. Kazuma is a young mercenary who lives in the Lost Ground, looking for any work he can find to sustain his livelihood within the harsh environment. He is one of the few people that are gifted with the Alter ability, which allows him to plaster his right arm and torso with a metallic alloy. title: Zhenshchina s kinzhalom
description: Ivan Savonsky, popular society artist, meets Olga Kartoff, a young woman high in social circles, and while she is instantly attracted by him, he sees in her only the perfect model for his picture, "The Dagger Woman." Studying her, and by carefully playing on her emotions he gains her confidence, and afterward she consents to pose for him. The picture completed, she is grieved and then angered to discover that Ivan's interest rests solely in it, and how it will fare at the exhibition. She pleads with him in vain. The picture is pronounced a masterpiece, and Ivan is in his triumph as he returns to his studio. Here Olga has secreted herself. Humiliated by the reports circulated regarding herself and the artist, and unable longer to bear his disinterest she plunges a dagger to his heart and kills him.

title: If Only
description: Follow the story of a 30-year-old woman who, when feeling dissatisfied with her marriage and family life, finds herself sent back in time 10 years following a lunar eclipse.

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

title: Free Money
description: When universal basic income (UBI) comes to the Kenyan village of Kogutu, lives are forever changed. GiveDirectly, one of the fastest growing nonprofits of the 21st century, is sending free money for twelve years as part of the world's largest UBI experiment. Filmmakers Lauren DeFilippo and Sam Soko juxtapose the story of these young economists, bankrolled by Silicon Valley and convinced that they have found an infallible algorithm to end world poverty, with portraits of local Kenyans whose lives are being dramatically impacted for better and for worse. UBI is at the forefront of political debate like never before, thanks to Andrew Yang's presidential candidacy, covid stimulus packages, and trials underway around the world. This documentary is a fascinating case study of life in a village-turned-petri-dish from the perspective of those living out this revolutionary idea.

title: « L’ART DE LA GUERRE » l’incroyable Film RMC Sport avant BSD v PIMBLETT | UFC 329
description: Benoît Saint Denis est revenu plus fort que jamais pour signer des victoires exceptionnelles face à Ruffy, Dariush et Hooker et se hisser en quelques mois seulement dans le Top 5 de la catégorie des -70kg de l’UFC, poussant son corps au-delà de ses limites. Face à lui, la superstar anglaise Paddy Pimblett, qui reste sur une défaite héroïque face à Justin Gaethje, l’homme qui vient de choquer la planète en brutalisant Ilia Topuria, que tout le monde pensait invincible, lui arrachant au passage la ceinture de champion. Découvrez comment Benoît Saint Denis est devenu une machine de guerre implacable aux côtés de Nicolas Ott, en trouvant le juste équilibre entre violence brute, discipline et stratégie. Pimblett est lui dans l’obligation de se relever : une deuxième défaite de rang le renverrait en salle d’attente de la catégorie et sous le feu nourri des critiques liées à son image de produit marketing et de chouchou du patron. Seul le vainqueur pourra prétendre à affronter Justin Gaethje pour la ceinture. title: Krafftówna w Krainie Czarów
description: A film, creative portrait of an outstanding theater and film actress, which takes the viewer to a world that does not exist anymore, because, as Barbara Krafftówna says in the film, "The huge world in which I lived is already on the other side of the mirror ..." Barbara Krafftówna becomes an ageless character in the film, or like a little Alice from a fairy tale, she crosses the border of realism. For years, it was the key to her acting. The film received a universal message: "Sky is the limit". Imagination has always been an escape from hopelessness for Krafftówna, because her biography, full of professional successes, was not without tragedy. Her life entered the difficult Polish history - Volhynia, the war, Stalinist times, communism, the fight for freedom. Imagination, as she put it herself, was "an escape from the void." The main narrative of the film consists of the protagonist's internal monologues, the archival ones collected over the years by the narrator and screenwriter of the film, Remigiusz Grzela, and those recorded today. These monologues refer to the most outstanding film role of Krafftówna in the film by Wojciech Jerzy Has, "How to Be Loved".

title: Herbert. Barbarzynca w ogrodzie
description: Polish author Zbigniew Herbert is one of the most remarkable poets of the 20th century. His works have been translated into 40 languages, acclaimed and awarded around the world, mainly because of its timeless and universal dimension. In Poland, his significance is even greater, as Herbert was a moral guide in his native country. His poetry was of great importance during the fight against communism. Many Poles learned his poems by heart and remember them up to this day. However, behind the crystalline beauty of his poetry, there is a man struggling with everyday life. His story told by his wife, Katarzyna, and people who were close to him unveils a picture of a unique, yet complex artist. A model of intelligence, humor and charm, on the one hand, Herbert has been struggling with anger, physical pain and mental illness, on the other.

title: Calor... y celos
description: Carlos prepares a trip a Cuba with his lover. His plans are spoiled when his wife makes up her mind to go to Havana with him.

title: Mosquita y Mari
description: After being assigned as study partners, two Chicana high schoolers find a bond that confuses them at times.

title: Adán y Eva
description: Men and women isolated in a beach area must live with potential partners, with the peculiarity of being completely naked all the time.

title: Cabeza y corazón
description: The only time the Spanish women's wheelchair basketball team participated in the Paralympic Games was in Barcelona in 1992, when Spain was granted the place as the host country without the need to qualify. Twenty-four years later, for the first time in history, the team once again has the chance to compete in the Paralympics. Despite having fewer resources than other countries' teams, the Spanish team is making its way against all odds in the international competitions. An intimate, player's-eye view follows the physical and psychological journey leading to the team's historic qualification for the Paralympic Games in Tokyo 2020-21.

title: Donaire y Esplendor
description: In the traditional carnival of the small town called Las Tablas, there are two rival streets: Up Street and Down Street. A young couple, after an unexpected encounter at the airport, fall hopelessly in love.

title: Marino y Esmeralda
description: Marino, 18, a young foreign film student, meets Esmeralda, 20, a student and a painter, in whom he finds the muse he always wanted for his camera. Soon he sees himself wanting to be what she is to him: her muse.

title: Aquí y ahora
description: A modern dancer must learn to juggle love, family, and her career while she auditions for a prestigious foreign dance company.

title: Pancho y Silpancho
description: Two truck drivers meet each other for the hazards of life in Santa Cruz, make a good friendship in the city of Cochabamba and travel throughout Bolivia and have their adventures with Treme, Cassandra and other characters.

title: Helena y Fernanda
description: An important industrialist suffers a neurosis. In a violent argument he strikes his wife and apparently kills her. Then the body disappears. Criminal melodrama inspired by a similar situation set out by Henri Georges Clouzot in 'Les diaboliques'.

title: Gen-Y Cops
description: After a lethal American attack robot, RS1, is unleashed onto the mean streets of Hong Kong, Asia's funkiest crime-fighting team finds themselves on the wrong side of then law.

title: Orgullo y Prejuicio
description: A pesar de la presión social para casarse, Lizzie Bennet, la segunda de las hermanas Bennet, está decidida a quedarse soltera. Pero cuando su padre cae gravemente enfermo, Lizzie se ve inesperadamente arrastrada al mundo clasista del cortejo con tal de salvar a su familia de la ruina. Tras un encuentro decisivo con el reservado y misterioso millonario, el señor Darcy, Lizzie se enfrenta a una elección: negar sus sentimientos por el bien de su familia o dejarse llevar por un amor tan apasionado como imprudente.

title: Z the Series
description: FADE IN: INT. ART'S KITCHEN - DAY Sam sits at kitchen table looking at a small portable television set, on the table, as Art enters kitchen. ART The cable is still out, you getting anything on that portable set? SAM Just a couple of emergency broadcasting channels with blank screens.I'm watching a government access channel but it keeps fading in and out. ART What are they talking about? SAM Nothing new...see? Close on screen of small portable television set on kitchen table. Three person panel discussion show on government access channel. PANELIST#1 ...and not only must everyone avoid anyone acting or moving strangely. They must, for their own protection, notify authorities of the death of anyone in their household or, for that matter, any deaths they are aware of... Art, putting on a denim jacket, walks to and picks up a shotgun, leaning against the wall. ART No local news broadcasts. That's not good. SAM They were on yesterday... ART Yea, yesterday. Alright, let's go try to pick up some supplies. Maybe make a few stops. Art walks to an open doorway as Sam stands and puts on denim jacket as she steps top and picks up a second shotgun.

title: Z pekla stestí
description: Once upon a time there was a farmer. His daughter Dora was mean, lazy and quarrelsome, but his stepdaughter Magareta was sweet, pretty and hardworking. So it happened that the servant Hannes fell in love with Magareta. When Hannes asks the farmer for Magareta's hand, the jealous Dora is disappointed. In revenge, she hands Hannes over to the king's soldier recruiters and drives Magareta out of the house. The and new strong friends help Hannes to save his Magareta and at the same time free the people from a tyrannical king.

title: The Holy Covenant Prophet
description:
Isora, a century-old demigoddess, sets out to reclaim twelve Sacred Covenants and seal the Abyss. Her journey takes her from a duke’s estate consumed by ambition to the shattered lands of Hawk and a northern fortress engulfed in eternal night. Along the way, she and the royal knight Seren go from bitter rivals to companions willing to die for each other.

When a prophecy foretells Seren’s brutal death for her sake, he steps in front of a blade to protect her. For the first time, Isora defies fate, forcing a Sacred Covenant into her beloved’s body to resurrect him and grant him extraordinary power. The two soon discover a vast conspiracy behind the Abyss’s awakening.

No longer slaves to prophecy, Isora and Seren seize control of their destiny. Rejecting the merciless pact of old, they advance together toward the heart of the Abyss. The nine remaining Sacred Covenants hold the key to ending the chaos and purging the darkness. Prophecy does not decide how their story ends—the human heart is the one force fate cannot predict.

title: My Billionaire Heir’s Possession
description:
Born into poverty, Allen Miller earns a scholarship to an elite academy, only to cross the campus “king”—billionaire heir Damian Black. When Allen is framed and faces expulsion, Damian intervenes decisively to save him. Allen believes he has found a savior, unaware that he has stepped into a carefully woven web of love.

As his childhood friend Serena’s jealousy and his former best friend Julian’s revenge plot come to light, Allen’s mother falls victim to a vicious attack, and Allen himself is repeatedly driven to the brink. Caught in a spiral of lies and betrayal, he discovers the hidden scars beneath Damian’s cold exterior—and realizes he has already fallen for him.

When the truth behind a powerful family’s bitter infighting is finally exposed, can these two lovers overcome society’s prejudice and the chains of family duty to make one lasting promise: “As long as you stay by my side, I will never leave yours”?

When the clock runs out, so does his patience — he tears up the contract and walks. Now she's the one left begging for a second chance.

title: Excel Basics for Data Analysis
description:
Spreadsheet tools like Excel are an essential tool for working with data - whether for data analytics, business, marketing, or research. This course is designed to give you a basic working knowledge of Excel and how to use it for analyzing data. 
 
This course is suitable for those who are interested in pursuing a career in data analysis or data science, as well as anyone looking to use Excel for data analysis in their own domain. No prior experience with spreadsheets or coding is required - all you need is a device with a modern web browser and the ability to create a Microsoft account to access Excel online at no cost. If you have a desktop version of Excel, you can also easily follow along with the course. 
 
Throughout this course, you'll gain valuable experience working with data sets and spreadsheets. We'll start by introducing you to spreadsheets like Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, and show you how to load data from multiple formats. From there, you'll learn how to perform basic data wrangling and cleansing tasks using functions, and expand your knowledge of data analysis through the use of filtering, sorting, and pivot tables. 
 
There is a strong focus on practice and applied learning in this course. With each lab, you'll have the opportunity to manipulate data and gain hands-on experience using Excel. You'll learn how to clean and format your data efficiently, and convert it into a pivot table to make it more organized and readable. The final project will allow you to showcase your newly acquired data analysis skills by working with real data sets and spreadsheets. 
 
By the end of this course, you'll have a solid foundation in using Excel for data analysis. You'll have worked with multiple data sets and spreadsheets, and will have the skills and knowledge needed to effectively clean and analyze data without having to learn any code. So let's get started!

This course is the first in a series that will allow you to expand your skills as an Android developer into the world of cross-platform mobile development. JavaScript is the programming language that powers the modern web. In this course, you will learn the basic concepts of web development with JavaScript. You will work with functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. You will learn how to use JavaScript and discover interactive possibilities with modern JavaScript technologies. Finally, you will learn about the practice of testing code and how to write a unit test using Jest.
This course can be applied to multiple Specializations or Professional Certificates programs. Completing this course will count towards your learning in any of the following programs:
•	Meta Android Developer Professional Certificate
•	Meta iOS Developer Professional Certificate
By the end of this course you will be able to:
•	Explain the basic concepts of web development with Javavscript. 
•	Practice using functions, objects, arrays, variables, data types, the HTML DOM, and much more. 
•	Use JavaScript within the React framework

title: Excel Skills for Business: Essentials
description:
In this first course of the specialization, 'Excel Skills for Business: Essentials', you will master the fundamental capabilities of Microsoft Excel. Over six weeks, you will gain the confidence to expertly navigate the Excel user interface, perform essential calculations using formulas and functions, professionally format spreadsheets, and create impactful data visualizations with charts and graphs.
This course is designed for aspiring business professionals, students, and anyone looking to enhance their digital skills. Whether you are new to Excel or self-taught and aiming to solidify your foundational knowledge for greater efficiency and productivity, this program provides a robust starting point. You will solve a variety of practical business problems, applying learned Excel skills and techniques through downloadable workbooks and real-world data sets.
To succeed in this course, no prior Excel experience is required. You will develop highly valuable spreadsheet software skills, positioning yourself for success in today's rapidly evolving digital job market.

title: English for Career Development
description:
Welcome to English for Career Development, a course created by the University of Pennsylvania, and funded by the U.S. Department of State Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs, Office of English Language Programs. 
To enroll in this course for free, click on “Enroll now” and then select "Full Course. No certificate."
This course is designed for non-native English speakers who are interested in advancing their careers in the global marketplace. In this course, you will learn about the job search, application, and interview process in the United States, while comparing and contrasting the same process in your home country. This course will also give you the opportunity to explore your global career path, while building your vocabulary and improving your language skills to achieve your professional goals. The first unit in this course will introduce the U.S. job application process and provide strategies for identifying the jobs that match your interests and skills. Unit 2 will take you through the steps necessary to produce a professional-looking resume. In unit 3, you will work to develop a clear and concise cover letter. The final unit of the course focuses on networking and interview skills.
Anyone may take this course for free. If you want to get a Coursera Verified Certificate for free, please fill out the Financial Aid form.
 Unless otherwise noted, all course materials are available for re-use, repurposing and free distribution under a Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution license.
Supplemental reading materials were provided by Newsela, which publishes daily news articles at a level that's just right for each English language learner.

title: Programming for Kids and Beginners: Learn to Code in Scratch 3.0
description:
Now with Scratch 3.0: learn to program, create games, have fun in Scratch! For kids and beginners, parents and teachers!

In this course, we'll learn to code, starting from the basic blocks. No kidding! Scratch, the programming language we use (developed by MIT), is so fun that it makes programming seem like a game.

We'll learn by doing. The course is designed so that you create the games and applications with your own two hands. But what makes this course truly unique is the teaching method I've used live for almost 4 years. We learn a variety of computer science topics, but we hide the complexity behind characters, animations, analogies and fun!

That's because, in these carefully designed lessons, we train our intuition to make sense of what we want to achieve and how to get there. This will help you quickly master the basics. After this course, you'll learn text-based programming languages at a blazing speed and quickly make sense of any piece of code.

The content is designed to be fun! We learn to create animations and cool effects and we create clones of some of the most popular games: Flappy Bird, Duck Hunt or Pac-Man. The games are handpicked to optimize learning computer science topics while having fun along the way. I will also update the course on a regular basis with new content - and challenges!

This course is designed for

parents or teachers who want to give their children the best skills and most fun
kids and beginners who want to learn to code games
anyone new to programming who doesn't know where to start
I can't wait to have you in the course!

The course is regularly updated with new material, tips and tricks that you can use in your games and projects!

Who this course is for:
Children (from 7-8 years)
Absolute beginners in programming and computer science

title: Pls.Love
description: Panapsorn has spent years surviving the glittering, merciless world of nightlife entertainment, remaining soft-spoken, selfless, and carrying wounds she learned to hide behind flawless smiles. Phakinee, on the other hand, has never had to hide anything. Beautiful, wealthy, and razor-sharp, she moves through life untouched by the things that break ordinary people, until she meets Panapsorn, whose quiet strength unsettles her in ways she cannot explain away. An unexpected encounter becomes a pull neither woman can escape. But in a world ruled by power, secrets, and the ghosts of what came before, choosing each other is an act of courage. A fierce, aching, modern sapphic romance about two women, one learning she deserves love and one discovering she can feel it, as they fight for a connection neither of them saw coming.

title: ERASED
description: Satoru Fujinuma is a 29 year old manga artist struggling to make a name for himself following his debut. But, that was not the only thing in his life that Satoru was feeling frustrated about… He has a unique supernatural ability of being forced to prevent deaths and catastrophes by being sent back in time before the incident occurred, repeating time until the accident is prevented. One day, he gets involved in an accident that has him framed as a murderer. Desperate to save the victim, he sends himself back in time only to find himself as a grade-schooler one month before fellow classmate Kayo Hinazuki went missing. Satoru now embarks on a new quest: to save Kayo and solve the mystery behind her disappearance.

title: Soul Eater [English]
description: Set in the Shinigami technical school for weapon meisters, the series revolves around 3 duo's. These pairs are a partnership between a weapon meister and a human weapon. Trying to reach a ranking of "Death Scythe" (and thus fit for use by the Shinigami) they must collect the souls of 99 evil humans and 1 witch. However, forces outside of the Academy make it more challenging of a feat causing trouble around the world.

After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

title: A Miracle a Day
description: The documentary film "A Miracle A Day," is an uplifting testament to the human spirit and it's capacity to surmount obstacles and transcend adversity. It is a portrayal of All Bengal Women's Union Welfare Home For Girls in Kolkata (Calcutta), India, which is a progressive present-day example of the older institutions depicted in the highly acclaimed film "Lion", whose story also took place in Kolkata. The home was founded in 1932 for women and girls to have a place of refuge from brothels, trafficking, poverty and abandonment. Today it is still thriving with residents ranging from one day old through their nineties. All Bengal Women's Union provides food, clothing, shelter, education and vocational training for 150 to 200 girls, young women, elderly and care for babies as well. The staff, many of whom are volunteers, show heartfelt and relentless dedication to helping every person become the best they can be.

What starts as reluctant coexistence gradually blossoms into admiration, affection, and ultimately, a sweet love story.
